description: This file defines the 'Review' controller class for handling review notification emails within the OpenCart platform. It loads product details, constructs email content, and schedules mail tasks based on review submissions.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: A controller class responsible for processing review submission notifications and sending email alerts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method triggered on review addition, constructs email notifications and queues tasks if alerts are enabled.
